definitions.explanation: Not approved or recognized by the relevant authority, organization, or governing body.

examples.japanese: {非公認|ひこうにん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧だ。
{非公認|ひこうにん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ファン→ファン：10065_fan⟧⟦クラブ→クラブ：10812_kurabu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: We started an unofficial fan club.

examples.japanese: ⟦{追|お}い{風|かぜ}→追い風：14352_oikaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{強|つよ}すぎた⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{非公認|ひこうにん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Because the tailwind was too strong, the time was not ratified as an official record.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {非公認|ひこうにん}⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧: an unofficial record
- {非公認|ひこうにん}⟦キャラクター→キャラクター：23518_kyarakutaa⟧: an unofficial mascot
- {非公認|ひこうにん}⟦{候補|こうほ}→候補：02804_kouho⟧: a candidate without the party's official endorsement

CULTURAL NOTE:
Local mascots (ゆる⟦キャラ→キャラ：08916_kyara⟧) are sometimes proudly {非公認|ひこうにん}: ふ⟦なっ→なる：01970_naru⟧しー became famous in the 2010s as an unofficial mascot of Funabashi city, never adopted by the city itself.
